title: Case Management Advanced
description: Master advanced case patterns, parent-child cases, case relationships, and complex case lifecycles

content.introduction: Advanced case management goes beyond simple case creation and processing. This lesson covers sophisticated case patterns, relationships, and lifecycle optimization techniques used in enterprise PEGA applications.

sections.title: Parent-Child Case Patterns
sections.content: Parent-child cases allow you to model complex business processes where multiple related cases must be managed together. Child cases inherit properties and behaviors from their parent while maintaining their own lifecycle.

patterns.name: Parallel Processing
patterns.useCase: Loan application with separate child cases for credit check, employment verification, and property appraisal

patterns.name: Sequential Processing
patterns.useCase: Insurance claim with sequential child cases for initial review, investigation, and settlement

patterns.name: Conditional Processing
patterns.description: Child cases created based on conditions
patterns.useCase: Customer onboarding with conditional child cases for different product types

sections.title: Case Relationships and Dependencies
sections.content: Define relationships between cases to ensure proper sequencing, data sharing, and status synchronization. Use case dependencies to prevent race conditions and ensure data integrity.

sections.title: Case Inheritance and Data Propagation
sections.content: Configure how data flows between parent and child cases. Child cases can inherit properties, attachments, and case data while maintaining their own unique identifiers.

sections.title: Case Transfers and Escalations
sections.content: Handle complex scenarios where cases need to be transferred between users, departments, or systems. Implement escalation rules and approval workflows.

sections.title: Performance Optimization
sections.content: Optimize case lifecycle performance through efficient case management patterns, caching strategies, and resource allocation.
